mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.notice.SysNoticeSellerMapper.getNotice */ SELECT NOTICE_ID , SUBJECT , CONTENT , HITS , (SELECT ATCH_FILE_SZ FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER_FILE WHERE NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID AND USE_YN = 'Y') as ATCH_FILE_SZ , BOARD_CODE , SUB_CATEGORY , NOTICE_FLAG , LOCGOV_CODE , USE_YN , FRST_CRT_ID , FRST_CRT_DT , LAST_MDFCN_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , DISPLAY_FLAG , LOCGOV_NM FROM ( SELECT N.NOTICE_ID , N.SUBJECT , N.CONTENT , N.HITS , N.BOARD_CODE , N.SUB_CATEGORY , N.NOTICE_FLAG , N.LOCGOV_CODE , L.LOCGOV_NM , N.USE_YN -- , M.USER_NAME , N.FRST_CRT_ID , N.FRST_CRT_DT , N.LAST_MDFCN_ID , N.LAST_MDFCN_DT , N.DISPLAY_FLAG FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER N -- LEFT JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON N.FRST_CRT_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON N.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND N.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A

/**cmnty-mapper.getFaqBbsfileList */ SELECT FILE_ID , NOTICE_ID , ORGNL_ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_EXTN_NM , ATCH_FILE_SZ , ATCH_FILE_SEQ , ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER_FILE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/**cmnty-mapper.getSysNoticeSellerFileDetail */ SELECT FILE_ID , NOTICE_ID , ORGNL_ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_EXTN_NM , ATCH_FILE_SZ , ATCH_FILE_SEQ , ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* saleson.shop.notice.SysNoticeSellerMapper.getFrontNoticeList */ SELECT N.notice_id, N.subject, N.content, N.hits, N.board_code, N.sub_category, N.notice_flag, N.frst_crt_id, N.frst_crt_dt, N.last_mdfcn_id, N.last_mdfcn_dt, CASE WHEN ADDDATE(N.frst_crt_dt, INTERVAL 3 DAY) >= THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS new_flag, N.display_flag, N.use_yn, N.locgov_code, (SELECT count(*) from OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER_FILE WHERE use_yn = 'Y' and notice_id = N.notice_id) as attached_file_cnt FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER N
ORDER BY IFNULL(notice_flag, 'N') DESC , CASE WHEN IFNULL(notice_flag, 'N') = 'Y' THEN notice_id ELSE 0 END DESC , frst_crt_dt DESC

/* saleson.shop.notice.SysNoticeSellerMapper.getFrontNotice */ SELECT NOTICE_ID , SUBJECT , CONTENT , HITS , (SELECT ATCH_FILE_SZ FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER_FILE WHERE NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID AND USE_YN = 'Y') as ATCH_FILE_SZ , BOARD_CODE , SUB_CATEGORY , NOTICE_FLAG , LOCGOV_CODE , USE_YN , FRST_CRT_ID , FRST_CRT_DT , LAST_MDFCN_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , DISPLAY_FLAG , LOCGOV_NM FROM ( SELECT N.NOTICE_ID , N.SUBJECT , N.CONTENT , N.HITS , N.BOARD_CODE , N.SUB_CATEGORY , N.NOTICE_FLAG , N.LOCGOV_CODE , L.LOCGOV_NM , N.USE_YN -- , M.USER_NAME , N.FRST_CRT_ID , N.FRST_CRT_DT , N.LAST_MDFCN_ID , N.LAST_MDFCN_DT , N.DISPLAY_FLAG FROM OP_SYS_NOTICE_SELLER N -- LEFT JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON N.FRST_CRT_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON N.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND N.USE_YN = 'Y' AND N.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' ) A
